notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion (August 2, 2019 during the second run, and January 15, 2019 during the first). The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.

The player can spend a multiple of 30 Millennium Coins (max. 300 at a time) to obtain one random reward for each 30 Millennium Coins spent. The Lottery remained available until August 2, 2019 (January 15, 2019 in the first run), after the event's conclusion, and could be accessed from the "Events/Campaigns" menu.
